title: Claude Code Security Flaw Leaks Secrets on GitHub
excerpt: A security issue in Anthropic's Claude Code has exposed passwords and API keys in over 1,000 public GitHub repositories.
body_html:
A configuration feature in Anthropic's AI coding assistant, Claude Code, has accidentally exposed sensitive passwords and API keys in public repositories on GitHub. Software security firm Apiiro revealed that 1,122 public copies of a project settings file contain unencrypted secrets.

The exposure occurs when users select the "Yes, and don't ask again" option during command approvals. When this choice is made, the assistant can record the command word-for-word, inadvertently saving sensitive details directly into project settings files that are later pushed to public code repositories.

Developers are advised to check their repositories for exposed configuration files to prevent unauthorized access to systems and accounts tied to the leaked credentials.
